# FUSE tuning on DICES-350 (generated by scripts/tune_dices350.py)

Dev half 174 conversations (choosing), test half 176 (scored once). A change is adopted when dev accuracy gains at least 2.0 points and dev AUC drops at most 0.5.

| Method | Accuracy | AUC | Predicted unsafe % |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Majority vote | 64.9 | 78.2 | 24 |
| Dawid–Skene | 66.1 | 77.8 | 34 |
| Crowd share, threshold tuned on dev (ceiling) | 74.7 | 78.2 | 56 |
